title: Pathfinder beacon: compact first-run tour and adaptive empty-state artboards
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and produce a compact, keyboard-first onboarding tour ("Pathfinder Beacon") and an adaptive set of empty-state artboards for the Console first-run experience. The goal is a low-friction 3-step checklist that fits into the top-right console chrome, with progressive disclosure of helpers and tips for new orgs. Artifacts must include light/dark variants, motion specs (micro-interactions), and accessible ARIA announcement guidelines so engineering can implement keyboard and screen-reader friendly flows.
deliverables: Figma file: 9 artboards (compact tour frames x3, expanded checklist, 4 empty-state variants)
Exportable PNG/SVG sprite sheets for hero illustrations (light/dark/compact)
Motion spec: Lottie demo + CSS timings (enter: 220ms ease-out, idle pulse: 1200ms, exit: 180ms ease-in)
Microcopy pack: short tooltips, CTA variants, fallback prompts for no-permissions state
Accessibility guide: ARIA roles, announcement text, and keyboard flows
acceptance_criteria: Tour fits within 320px width when in compact mode and does not overlap core nav at common breakpoints
All text passes 4.5:1 contrast for body copy in both light and dark themes
Keyboard-only flow: focusable next/skip/back controls, Esc closes and announces closure
Empty states provide targeted CTAs for three primary org personas: engineer, product manager, platform admin
Exported assets include optimized SVGs and 2x PNGs labeled with naming convention: pathfinder_<variant>_<theme>@2x.png

design_risks: Complex animations may impact render performance on older machines — mitigated by reduced-motion variants and optional cross-fade
Copy overload in compact mode — mitigated by progressive disclosure and a single-line summary in the compact state
Permissions edge cases (user sees empty state but lacks permissions) — solved by explicit fallback CTAs and link to permission help center
